summary_answer: Robbery involves the act of theft by one or more persons, while dacoity specifically involves five or more persons committing or attempting to commit robbery together.
detailed_answer: The primary difference between robbery and dacoity lies in the number of individuals involved in the crime. Robbery can be committed by one or more persons, but dacoity specifically requires the involvement of five or more persons acting together. According to Section 310(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, when five or more persons commit or attempt to commit robbery, they are said to commit dacoity. Additionally, both robbery and dacoity can lead to severe penalties, especially if they involve causing hurt or using deadly weapons, as outlined in Sections 309(6) and 311 Body.
final_answer: Robbery is committed by one or more persons, while dacoity requires five or more persons acting together.
